name: hubspot-central-brain
description: HubSpot Central Brain — hub-and-spoke system for developer advocacy

scripts.validate: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.build: esbuild src/app/functions/LinearWebhook.ts src/app/functions/SyncToLinear.ts src/app/functions/AppSettingsApi.ts src/app/functions/SyncToAsana.ts src/app/functions/AsanaWebhook.ts src/app/functions/AsanaPoll.ts src/app/functions/FellowSync.ts src/app/functions/ContentDataApi.ts src/app/functions/TaskStatusApi.ts src/app/functions/RelatedContentApi.ts src/app/functions/AssociateRelatedContent.ts src/app/functions/MeetingIntelligenceApi.ts src/app/functions/GenerateSocialDraft.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --outdir=src/app/functions
scripts.upload: npm run build && hs project upload
scripts.upload:dev: npm run build && hs project upload --profile=dev
scripts.upload:staging: npm run build && hs project upload --profile=staging
scripts.upload:prod: npm run build && hs project upload --profile=prod
